messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: make test-models failing on fresh develop clone
parts:
On Saturday, May 25, 2013 4:33:23 PM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
I vaguely remember Daniel saying something about running
lower than -j4?

If parallel testing sometimes doesn't catch test errors or failures, that is a separate (but bad) bug, although paralleling does jumble up the output.

But you can just do make test/mode/command serially to trigger the problem, which bisects to

running ./test.sh
a5719d9a96b6b6af65ca66a7e3f8d1482639df3d is the first bad commit
commit a5719d9a96b6b6af65ca66a7e3f8d1482639df3d
Author: Michael Betancourt <betanalpha@gmail.com>
Date:   Sun Apr 21 00:57:29 2013 +0100

    Use pointer to stream instead of reference to stream to allow for null streams

:040000 040000 9c5fee91c0e51a7cfc710e8567233ee14380b42a 5acbda183ce1f352165cb5d8b5275a6e0d8ed593 M      src
bisect run success

Except that commit was just a build failure. Fortunately, this was close enough to HEAD that it will be easy enough to find the problem by moving up the log, which has a bunch of build failures toward the end:

goodrich@CYBERPOWERPC:/opt/stan$ git bisect log
git bisect start
# bad: [6f38377fbb6e92ffafad3b5b4a235c5b32f4be99] Merge branch 'develop' of https://github.com/stan-dev/stan into develop
git bisect bad 6f38377fbb6e92ffafad3b5b4a235c5b32f4be99
# good: [194702cc2e234605b27ccfa4ff55626dd46c88af] pass -DGTEST_USE_OWN_TR1_TUPLE via CFLAGS_GTEST in makefile
git bisect good 194702cc2e234605b27ccfa4ff55626dd46c88af
# bad: [9ebffa76ce4289549bfb7222ed423580eb78dff6] Unified sampler output through mcmc_writer, updating output to include more information in samples.csv as well as introducing an explicit diagnostic dump option.  Tested and freshly merged with develop.
git bisect bad 9ebffa76ce4289549bfb7222ed423580eb78dff6
# bad: [ba7d25da524c6d1c9f8b1cf00345045be64f0552] Updated CSV reader test
git bisect bad ba7d25da524c6d1c9f8b1cf00345045be64f0552
# bad: [3be3f8e7656c23e8ac6a364aaa86a18b259640d9] Fixed creation/use of diagnostic stream, use mcmc_writer for all sampling output
git bisect bad 3be3f8e7656c23e8ac6a364aaa86a18b259640d9
# bad: [a614178d3bcd3fd77edd3fb44d30e05c0b2e9efb] Intermediate reworking of command to use mcmc_writer
git bisect bad a614178d3bcd3fd77edd3fb44d30e05c0b2e9efb
# bad: [9cdb317c23c92f8acc52ef9dccdf17769697c163] Added write_sampler_state for general implementation display
git bisect bad 9cdb317c23c92f8acc52ef9dccdf17769697c163
# bad: [a5719d9a96b6b6af65ca66a7e3f8d1482639df3d] Use pointer to stream instead of reference to stream to allow for null streams
git bisect bad a5719d9a96b6b6af65ca66a7e3f8d1482639df3d
# first bad commit: [a5719d9a96b6b6af65ca66a7e3f8d1482639df3d] Use pointer to stream instead of reference to stream to allow for null streams

Ben
